card.name: Fractions and small amounts in dosing
card.fires_on: Fraction or small-quantity pieces in dose text, such as the 2 in 1/2, the word half after one, ½, or the 1 in 0.01. Also the space before a number after a colon in dose lines.

modes.label: Fractions of a unit
modes.description: The denominator, half, or ½ in a fractional tablet or teaspoon amount.
modes.example: followed by 0.3 mg (1/<<2>> tablet) 1 hour later.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: A blank gap right before a dose figure in a dosing line.

modes.label: Decimal multiples
modes.description: The last digit of a small decimal in a dose-multiple comparison.

card.plain: It lights up on parts of fractions and small amounts in dose instructions, like half a tablet.
